parameter.name: find_all_ports
parameter.value: SELECT * FROM listener_port ORDER BY port_id

parameter.name: find_enabled_ports
parameter.value: SELECT * FROM listener_port WHERE is_disabled = false ORDER BY port_id

parameter.name: find_all_certs
parameter.value: SELECT * FROM ca_issued_cert ORDER BY issued_timestamp DESC

parameter.name: find_revoked_certs
parameter.value: SELECT * FROM ca_issued_cert WHERE revoked = true

parameter.name: audit_insert
parameter.value: INSERT INTO audit_log (event_time, username, client_ip, action, target, outcome, detail) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

parameter.name: audit_select
parameter.value: SELECT event_time, username, client_ip, action, target, outcome, detail FROM audit_log

parameter.name: audit_page
parameter.value: ORDER BY event_time DESC, audit_id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

parameter.name: security_select
parameter.value: SELECT password_changed, password_history, totp_secret, totp_enabled, totp_last_step FROM console_user_security WHERE username = ?

parameter.name: security_update
parameter.value: UPDATE console_user_security SET password_changed = ?, password_history = ?, totp_secret = ?, totp_enabled = ?, totp_last_step = ? WHERE username = ?

parameter.name: security_insert
parameter.value: INSERT INTO console_user_security (password_changed, password_history, totp_secret, totp_enabled, totp_last_step, username) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

parameter.name: setting_update
parameter.value: UPDATE console_setting SET value = ? WHERE name = ?
